dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region contains multiple irregular closed 'O' shapes with sharp, high-intensity white perimeters. These structures exhibit a high-gradient transition from the light exterior boundary to a darker pigmented interior. The anterior section features a prominent 'C' shaped structure with a scalloped, high-contrast edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the cranial region and lower lateral flanks. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, high-contrast points against the darker base pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli along the mid-dorsal ridge form an elongated irregular quadrilateral. Three smaller high-intensity blobs in the anterior-lateral region form an approximately equilateral triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary annular structures are interconnected by thin, high-intensity bridges, creating a reticulated or chain-like network across the central lateral field.
